messages:
sara: quick idea - can we rework how fallback decisions surface in the console so product/SRE can triage without hunting logs? want a compact card + reason drilldown.

tom: yes. compact card should show: severity (info/warn/critical), fallback_type, brief cause, and a link to audit. no raw payloads.

jess: also we need a filter in the table for 'only escalations' (critical + operator_override=false). saves people time.

arjun: API note: prefer GET /v1/rollouts/decisions/:id returning flat kv pairs. keep the response scalar values only (strings/numbers/booleans). avoid nested arrays for quick indexing.

sara: retention/socialization question - how long should full audit traces live? default proposal = 90 days, with tiered retention for enterprise. shorter for sampled traces.

jess: agree 90d default. add an export button (CSV) for matched decisions in a time window. ops teams love that for postmortems.

tom: UI copy idea: "Degraded to Safe Mode — persistent 95th p90 latency breach" with a tiny k-anonymized id. e.g., "aid-dec-1798899001".

arjun: telemetry we need emitted per decision (flat tags): decision_id, policy_name, rule_name, trigger_enum, sample_rate_pct, downstream_error_pct, upstream_latency_p95_ms, route_id, org_hash, operator_action. these are enough for dashboards.

sara: PII: do not store request text. instead store SHA256(prefix) + token_count + redaction_flag. display "sampled snippet available" only when legal ok.

ops-bot: info: fallback_sampled(eng-api) count=12 in last 10m.

jess: sampling heuristics: prefer adaptive sampling (higher sample rate during spikes), but always keep 1% baseline for long tail analysis.

tom: operator overrides: two flows - "temp" (TTL editable) and "permanent" (requires change ticket id). show TTL countdown on card and note who performed override.

arjun: decision enums we will accept: backend_unavailable, qos_breach, safety_flag, quota_burn, latency_spike, misrouted. will document in api spec.

sara: console UX: when you click "view reason" open a side panel with breadcrumbs (metrics snapshot), policy snippet (non-sensitive), related decisions (search by hashed prefix), and a CTA to open the audit log. keep it read-only.

jess: add a small cost impact line: "est. unit cost delta: +X%" so business can triage whether fallback is driving spend.

tom: on telemetry naming, prefer dot-separated keys for metrics: fallback.policy, fallback.trigger, fallback.severity. easier to query in metrics stores.

arjun: I will draft the flat response example as plain text in the API doc (no nested). Example row: decision_id, ts, policy, rule, trigger, severity, sample_pct, p95_ms, err_pct, route, org_hash, override_by.

sara: ok next steps: arjun to open draft PR with api + telemetry schema, jess to prototype the card in figma, tom to add filters for escalations in the table. I'll draft a short RFC on retention and sampling.

ops-bot: deploy: rollout/cascade-v3 canary -> monitoring.

arjun: noted. will ensure decision_id format uses org hash prefix. e.g., "org123-aid-dec-..."

sara: thanks all. i'll consolidate notes and post a short RFC. if anyone wants different defaults for TTL or retention shout now. :shipit:
